defect: A broad false path through shared_net also cuts the synchronous dst_clk_i path into dst_seen_q.
rationale: shared_net fans out to an asynchronous synchronizer and to dst_seen_q in the same dst_clk_i domain. A -through exception on the net removes both paths, hiding a real synchronous timing path instead of scoping the exception to the crossing.

mutation.description: Applied one net-wide -through false path to a net with both an asynchronous crossing and a synchronous consumer.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: The shared_net is not confined to the asynchronous path; the through-net false path also cuts the ordinary dst-clock mode_q to dst_seen_q path.
